title: Bean and veg chilli with rice
summary: A cheap, hearty pot that feeds the week.
steps: Start the rice if it isn't cooked yet: brown rice takes 25 to 30 minutes (follow the pack). Leftover rice is fine; reheat it until steaming hot.
Chop the onion and green pepper. Drain and rinse the beans and corn if they are tinned.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the onion and pepper for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in a pinch each of chilli, cumin and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the beans, tomatoes and corn, bring to a simmer and cook gently for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Add a splash of water if it catches.
Season with salt and pepper and serve over the rice.
